items.title: George P. Fleming Interview, 1984-10-06
items.q: I left Joe Robichaux uh in 1937 right and I went back with Sidney Desvane back on the boat in 1938

ctx.x: And Jim Robison and George Lewis was playing. One of them was playing at the Fern, the other one was playing at the Levita, whether it was Jim Robison or all of it. Well, now they had Joe Robichaux in the band with Gene Ware and I don't remember the other guy but I do remember Joe Robichaux was playing. No, it was not Joe Robichaux. I'm sorry about that.
